Golder Associates Ltd. and Thorn Associates (2021). Canadian Steel Industry Energy & Greenhouse Gas Emissions Intensity, Technology and Carbon Reduction Roadmap. Report 19135596 submitted to the Canadian Steel Producers Association, Ottawa, November 2021. https://canadiansteel.ca/files/resources/Golder-Report-CSPA-NRCan.pdf

Locators are printed page numbers (main body PDF page = printed + 7; roman-numbered front matter; Appendices A-C each restart at p.1 and are cited 'App. X p.N'). Updates the 2007 CIPEC benchmarking with 2018 data from CSPA member plants. Main file (6 technologies): the printed process-area averages for Canadian plants: cokemaking 6,864 MJ/t coke (no COG credit), blast furnace net 14,631 MJ/t hot metal (net of BFG credit), BOF net 284 MJ/t liquid steel (net of BOF gas credit), EAF plus continuous casting 3,051 MJ/t, hot rolling 2,464 MJ/t, bar mill 2,166 MJ/t; derived electricity (EAF, 71%) and fuel (hot rolling 78%, bar mill 85%) from printed shares. Totals loaded with blank target because they mix fuel, electricity, steam and O2/N2 embodied energy. _other-values: route-level GHG intensities (EAF 417, integrated 1,389 kg CO2e/t crude steel, Scope 1+2), EAF/integrated ratios, conversion and emission factors (App. B), shipping Scope 3. Not loaded: plant-by-plant values and process-area GHG intensities (only in unlabelled stacked-bar charts, confidentiality rule of 3+ plants); Table 5/6 and Figs. 12-22 technology penetration rankings (qualitative 1-6 survey scores); Appendix C technology descriptions (qualitative, literature-reprinted, no costs); Section 6 roadmap (qualitative). The report has no cost data.

(1) EAF process area: text says 'MJ per tonne of liquid steel', Fig. 7 axis says 'MJ / tonne of cast steel'; the area covers EAF plus continuous casting. (2) Sect. 5.3 refers to 'the methodology described in Section 6.1' for the 417 kg CO2e/t value; the method is in Sect. 3. (3) Shares (71%, 78%, 85%) are printed as approximate averages; the derived carrier values inherit that rounding. (4) Sect. 2.1 counts 7 EAF plants; hot rolling average is across 9 plants (includes integrated mills). (5) Grid factor text: '50% of EAF production ... less than 1.6 gCO2e/kWh or less' vs Table B2 1.3 g for QC/MB.
